title: Venials subdivided: of their kind vs. from imperfect performance
source_text: VI. Porro peccata ista venialia in duo rursus genera dividunt. Docent enim quaedam esse venialia ex genere suo; alia vero tantum ex imperfectione operis.
pass_a_gloss: Further, they divide those venial sins again into two kinds. For they teach that some are venial from their own kind; but others only from the imperfection of the work.
pass_b_english: Roman casuistry splits venials again: some venial by their kind, others only by imperfect performance.
The second class turns on how the act is done, not on a milder species of object.
